verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Ollama can run multiple models concurrently, but nothing documents any control over how context memory is allocated across those instances. Concurrency alone is an adjacent capability, not the allocation control the story asks for. One community comment says Ollama hides server configuration behind its own defaults, which reinforces the lack of evidence.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can control how context memory is allocated when running multiple model instances concurrently
